name: PrimaryNav - Derived Chapters
description: The header menu with the Chapters dropdown hovered open. The five chapter links are not authored anywhere in nav.json — they are generated from the chapters collection at render time, ordered by each chapter's order field and labelled with its own city. The other four groups are the hand-authored ones an editor still edits under /admin, and they render identically, which is the point: derived and authored items are indistinguishable in the markup.
